Title: Full set of Windows PowerShell cmdlets for Azure API Management API

Body.Content: A full set of Windows PowerShell cmdlets for the Azure API Management API is available via the standard Azure PowerShell installer. For installation instructions, see How to install and configure Azure PowerShell.
